# `utils/InterpolationCurves.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/utils/InterpolationCurves.js`

InterpolationCurves - Animation and motion interpolation utilities Wraps engine's easing and Bezier with editor-specific interpolators. Provides smooth transitions for: - Camera movements - Entity animations - Timeline scrubbing - UI transitions

## Classes

### `class AnimationTrack`

| `constructor` | `constructor()` |  |

| `removeKeyframe` | `removeKeyframe(time, tolerance = 0.001)` | Remove keyframe at time |
| `evaluate` | `evaluate(time)` | Evaluate track at time |

## Functions

### `smoothstep(t)`

Smoothstep interpolation (Hermite)

### `smootherstep(t)`

Smootherstep (Ken Perlin's improved version)

### `springInterpolation(t, stiffness = 100, damping = 10)`

Spring interpolation with damping

### `bounceInterpolation(t)`

Bounce interpolation

### `lerp(from, to, t, easing = 'linear')`

Interpolate between two values with easing

**Parameters:**

- `from` *(number)* — Start value
- `to` *(number)* — End value
- `t` *(number)* — Progress [0, 1]
- `easing` *(string|Function)* — Easing function or name

### `lerpVec3(from, to, t, easing = 'linear')`

Interpolate between two vec3s with easing

### `slerp(q1, q2, t, easing = 'linear')`

Spherical linear interpolation for quaternions (SLERP)

**Parameters:**

- `q1` *(number[])* — Start quaternion [x, y, z, w]
- `q2` *(number[])* — End quaternion [x, y, z, w]
- `t` *(number)* — Progress [0, 1]
- `easing` *(string|Function)* — Optional easing

### `catmullRom(points, t, closed = false)`

Catmull-Rom spline interpolation (passes through all control points)

**Parameters:**

- `points` *(Array)* — Array of control points
- `t` *(number)* — Progress [0, 1] across entire spline
- `closed` *(boolean)* — Whether spline is closed loop

### `bSpline(points, t, degree = 3)`

B-Spline interpolation (smooth curve, doesn't pass through control points)

### `hermite(p0, m0, p1, m1, t)`

Hermite spline interpolation

**Parameters:**

- `p0` *(number[])* — Start point
- `m0` *(number[])* — Start tangent
- `p1` *(number[])* — End point
- `m1` *(number[])* — End tangent
- `t` *(number)* — Progress [0, 1]

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
